title: Occurrence, ecological impact, and exposure risk of emerging contaminant REEs in a coastal river
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, 28,294-305
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00549C, Paper
Shunrong Ma, Guilin Han
Land-use and geochemical mapping show clear spatial gradients of ΣREE in the Jiulong River basin, highlighting human-driven enrichment and cumulative ecological risks in a coastal watershed.
